answer: Here is one concrete wall: Cooper apprenticeship record with brewery attestation. It works because each record is barrels built and tested for a brewery, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real coopers, and the vertex it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the garden is that the farm's unit economics never work. The onyx is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
